background: State Bank of India (UK) Limited is the UK subsidiary of State Bank of India, India's largest bank and majority-owned by the Indian government, offering retail deposits, remittances and property lending to the Indian community and businesses in Britain.
synthesis: None of Fitch, S&P or Moody's publishes a rating on the UK subsidiary, and the site holds no capital or liquidity figures for it, so there is no peer comparison to make. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days. Any comfort comes from the state-owned parent rather than from anything published about the entity itself, so this is a parental-support name: the question for a depositor is how far State Bank of India would stand behind its London subsidiary, and nothing shown here answers it.
